meta.title: AI Job Application Copilot
meta.description: Analyze jobs, tailor resumes, generate cover letters, and score application fit.

footer.tagline: Human-in-the-loop · No fabricated experience · Approval required before submit

login.subtitle: Sign in with your Google account to save applications and view your history.
login.privacy: We only use your Google profile to identify your account. No posts or emails are sent.

applications.title: My Applications
applications.subtitle: Track jobs you've analyzed and applied to.

errors.signInToSave: Please sign in to save your application
errors.provideJobInfo: Please enter company, job title, or description
errors.invalidFileType: Only PDF, DOC, and DOCX formats are supported

job.title: Analyze job description
job.subtitle: Paste a job URL or fill in company, title, and description. AI analysis is optional.
job.optionalHint: You can save job details without AI analysis and go straight to tracking your application.
job.importHint: Some sites require login or block scraping; if import fails, paste the job description directly.

resume.title: Upload resume
resume.subtitle: Upload your resume to enable tailoring, cover letters, and match scoring. You can skip this step and save the application with job details only.
resume.signInPrompt: Sign in with your Google account to save your resume and application history.
resume.completeJobFirst: Enter job information in the Job step first.
resume.uploadPrompt: Click or drag to upload resume

tailor.title: Tailor resume
tailor.subtitle: Optional. Generate an ATS-optimized version of your resume for this job.
tailor.uploadResumeFirst: Upload a resume in the previous step first.
tailor.completeJobFirst: Enter job information in the Job step first.
tailor.optionalHint: This step is optional. You can skip tailoring and save your application directly.
tailor.completeJobStep: Please complete job analysis in the Job step first.

coverLetter.title: Cover letter
coverLetter.subtitle: Optional. Generate a cover letter based on your resume and this job.
coverLetter.uploadResumeFirst: Upload a resume first to generate a cover letter.

match.title: Match score
match.subtitle: Save this job to track your application. AI analysis, resume upload, and tailoring are all optional.
match.signInPrompt: Sign in to save this application to your history.
match.saved: Application saved. View it in My Applications.
match.completeJobFirst: Enter job information in the Job step first.
